description:
“Life is a combination of magic and pasta” Federico Fellini

Both the hosts are covid 19 vaccinated (booster included)
I will sanitize the workspace and restroom space prior to the class, but keep in mind there is only one bathroom.

Do you want to know how to cook a real fresh Italian pasta with all the tricks that made Italy the country of Pasta? I’m going to teach you all the knowledge that my family (especially my grandmother) passed down to me since I was very little.

We are going to start off with touching and knowing the right ingredients (imported from Italy), and then get ready to get your hands really dirty! We are going to prepare two kinds of pasta: tortelli filled with fresh local ricotta and spinach, and tagliatelle. While mixing with your hands, we cheers with unlimited wine to good food and good company! While we are waiting for the pasta dough to rest we will enjoy a real Italian aperitivo with a charcuterie board. Salute!

This experience can be vegetarian friendly.

This class can’t be suitable for Gluten Free or Vegan.

To finish off the evening we are going to dine with your just made fresh pasta.

PS: since the wine is unlimited, it is our responsibility to make sure that everyone is safe. Therefore if we believe someone is too intoxicated, we will stop serving that individual.
locationDescription:
Our workshop will take place in my apartment in Brooklyn, my husband 100 years old great grandmothers house and we will make you feel like home! In front there is the view of the park, very bright and sunny! Also, if you are a plant lover you will enjoy my 10 years old monstera and other tropic house plants!
The door is on the left with the Ring bell

reviews.text: Michela and her husband were amazing! They were so friendly and welcoming! We had tons of amazing wine and making the pasta was so much fun! She was a great teacher, told stories about her time in Italy! They got a beautiful charcuterie board together, with local jams and cheeses it was such an amazing experience! Hopefully we can come again soon 💕

This was such a fun experience! Michela and Joseph were great hosts! They're super welcoming and friendly. My husband and I had such an amazing time taking this class and being with great company. We went in not knowing what to expect but it was a day well spent! Would highly recommend taking this class! Thank you to both Michela and Joe!

I surprised my wife with this experience for her birthday and we absolutely loved it. We are not very good cooks but this was so simple to follow we enjoyed it very much. Michaela and Joe were so welcoming and friendly it made the experience even better. We would definitely recommend to all.

If you are able to do this- it is a super special experience that is a once in a lifetime opportunity. Michela and Joe are so lovely and gracious- their home is cozy- and pasta making was so much easier with Michela's help.
Great hosts! It was a wonderful class with great company. To finish the night off with great pasta and wine is a plus too!

What a great eve spent learning new skills and meeting beautiful people. Michela and Joe were very welcoming, class was well run, conversations over dinner were memorable. Def a highlight of my trip. Cheers!

Absolutely incredible experience. Joe and Michela are the most warm, talented, and friendly hosts who shared their expertise on pasta-making and generosity. We made two delicious types of pasta and enjoyed lovely antipasti and wine. I can't recommend this experience highly enough. Grazie!!!
